models_evaluated: GPT-4 chatbot with chain-of-thought prompting and external knowledge integration

links.outcome: Harmful or inadequate recommendations, GPT-4 chatbot vs antimicrobial stewardship program (ASP) expert recommendations
links.effect: Chatbot had higher combined harmful or inadequate rate (13%) than ASP (4%, p = 0.047); antibiotic therapy harmful recommendations up to 10% (p<0.05).
links.quote: The chatbot had a significantly higher rate of harmful or inadequate recommendations (13%) compared to ASP (4%, p = 0.047).

links.outcome: Clinical safety and adequacy of chatbot recommendations in real-world cases, rated by ID physicians
links.effect: 13% harmful or inadequate recommendations overall; source control inadequate in 10% vs 2% for ASP (p = 0.022); BCID2 interpretation 100% accurate.
links.quote: The chatbot performed well in BCID2 interpretation (100% accuracy) but provided more inadequate responses in source control consideration (10% vs. 2% for ASP, p = 0.022).

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4 using chain-of-thought prompting on real-world bacteremia cases compared to human infectious disease experts, but does not test a comparative deployment guardrail or practice.
